scope: Exercise extracted segment selection against independent allowed-section masks. Two-device, eight-section modeled maps; new-section selection, aliases/pinning, zoned policies, one/two segments and sections per zone, hints and occupied maps. Not actual allocator concurrency, hardware, mount, storage or runtime testing.
native_policy_limits: Existing allocation hints can override ONLY_SEQ preference; zone separation can return EAGAIN for pinned allocations despite available conventional sections. Both cases executed against the native selector. No full availability guarantee asserted for zoned policies.
